d:
Ulhasnagar ka famous desi burger ab ghar par! Chana dal wali aloo tikki + chaat chole
Masala Kitchen mein Poonam Devnani se seekhiye thele wala desi burger (Sindhi burger): chana dal ka masaledar filling, bina pyaaz-lahsun ke chaat wale chole aur crispy heart shape aloo tikki, sab ghar ke bun mein. Thele par ₹30 ki tikki chole plate aur ₹70 ka burger milta hai, ab wahi swad ghar par.
Chana dal filling wali crispy aloo tikki
Chaat wale chole bina pyaaz-lahsun ke
Ghar ke bun mein desi burger ki layering
Dal ka paani masale mein daalne ki trick, masala nahi jalta
